why: The model makes this **Air Force by 8.2**; Vegas has **Air Force by 10.0**. That's a **1.8-point** gap in Northern Illinois's favor.
Air Force is the better team (#85 of 138 FBS overall vs. Northern Illinois at #129 of 138 FBS), but the model sees a smaller gap than the 10.0-point line implies.
Northern Illinois is at home, though home field is worth only about 1.1 pts in conference games.
The line has moved 1.5 pts toward Northern Illinois since it opened (Northern Illinois +11.5 → Northern Illinois +10.0), so bettors are agreeing with the model.
watch: Service-academy option offenses shorten games in ways this model doesn't capture.
The model only sees points, yards and home field. It knows nothing about injuries, weather or motivation.
